subject.title: Create Claw agent and root install record

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor and land this consent-bound Claw mutation and root-provenance contract as the second RFC slice, and may it land before the status/doctor/remove recovery slices are complete?
rationale: The patch establishes new CLI, config-mutation, SQLite ownership, recovery, and compatibility contracts; code review cannot determine whether that experimental lifecycle should become a maintained core product surface or how much of the stack must land atomically.

options.title: Approve ordered stack landing
options.body: Land after the read-only base PR, require exact-head recovery proof, and keep the mutating workflow unreleased until status, doctor, and removal recovery are available.

options.title: Require one lifecycle PR
options.body: Combine the mutation, managed workspace, package ownership, status, and removal slices so maintainers can review and land one complete recovery contract.

options.title: Pause the RFC direction
options.body: Keep the branch open but do not land the new CLI and persistent-state surface until maintainers explicitly sponsor the Claws product direction.

recommendation.title: Approve ordered stack landing
recommendation.body: Land after the read-only base PR, require exact-head recovery proof, and keep the mutating workflow unreleased until status, doctor, and removal recovery are available.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the public agent CLI and whether an experimental lifecycle becomes an owned, releaseable core contract.
